inventoryprofiles.config.description.dir:
When true 'scroll wheel up' will always move items from the player inventory to the chest
and 'scroll wheel down' will always move items from the chest to the player inventory.

When false 'scroll wheel up' will move items from the inventory under the cursor to the other inventory
 and 'scroll wheel down' will move items from the other inventory to the inventory under the cursor.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.dis:
When true scrolling won't move non empty bundles and will allow vanilla handling.
When false scrolling will move non empty bundles

inventoryprofiles.config.description.aut:
Press this shortcut to toggle Auto Refill for the slot under the cursor.
You can also move the mouse while holding it to toggle multiple slots.
Only Hotbar and gear slots are supported.

Makes all possible globally bookmarked trades.

Trades for all global bookmarks until all
resources are exhausted or no more trading is possible.
inventoryprofiles.tooltip.do_local_trade:

inventoryprofiles.tooltip.set_local_book:
Adds local bookmark.

inventoryprofiles.tooltip.set_global_boo:
Adds global bookmark.

Bookmarks this trade type for all Villagers of that profession,
or to all Wandering Traders.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.tre: If set to true, non-stackable items will be treated as full stacks when sorting by quantity.
inventoryprofiles.config.description.inv:
If set to true, clicking on bundles will be inverted. This can be useful if you have a mod that changes how you get/put items from/in bundles.
If when sorting puts items in bundles toggle this!

If set to true, clicking on shulkers will be inverted. This can be useful if you have a mod that changes allows you to put/extract items from shulkers.
If when sorting puts items in shulkers toggle this!
